name: Fungus (budding yeast)
short_description: Eukaryotic budding yeast (Candida-type, ~3–5 µm) with a daughter bud and germ tube; nucleus + organelles inside a chitin/β-glucan wall.

textbook.1: ❌ FAIL — correct anatomy but the whole cutaway was plastered with baked-in, misspelled text labels.
textbook.2: ✅ PASS — clean line-art cutaway: layered wall, membrane-bound nucleus, mitochondria, vacuole, ER+ribosomes, bud at a constricted neck, germ tube; no text.
textbook.3: ✅ PASS — re-rendered in colour: golden cell body, cyan membrane line, blue nucleus, teal vacuole, red-orange mitochondria, purple ER/ribosomes, bud at a constricted neck, germ tube. Matches the coloured house textbook style.
textbook.4: ✅ PASS — re-rendered in the refined rod-bacterium/parasite textbook style: muted desaturated palette, thin outlines, soft shading.

sem.1: ✅ PASS — single ovoid budding yeast, daughter bud at a constricted neck, circular bud scar, short germ tube; surface only.

3d.1: ✅ PASS — cutaway with layered wall, membrane-bound nucleus, vacuole, mitochondria, ER+ribosomes; bud at a neck + germ tube.

watercolor.1: ✅ PASS — watercolor cutaway: nucleus with nucleolus, large vacuole, mitochondria, ribosome dots, layered wall; bud + germ tube.
watercolor.2: ✅ PASS — re-rendered full-bleed on warm aged paper (no sheet/mat/border), cocci/rod style; layered wall, nucleus, vacuole, mitochondria, bud + germ tube.
